with claude on the PATH, setup runs:
  claude mcp add --scope project factory -- roomctl mcp

otherwise: add this to .mcp.json (roomctl setup never edits a config):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "factory": {
      "command": "roomctl",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}

setup installs the factory-handoff skill in .claude/skills
